changes.comment: Code organization refactor stage 5 item 12: added json-shape.ts (isPlainObject, moved out of config-validate.ts as a generic primitive; new asString/nonEmptyString) and error-info.ts (errorMessage/errorInfo/ErrorInfo, the canonical home for the copy every dreamux-internal package previously vendored). config-validate.ts now builds isPlainObject-dependent checks on top of json-shape.ts instead of defining its own.
